blurb: Patriot Sailing offers private and group sailing lessons for beginners and those wishing to improve their skills, including a 2.5 hour "Introduction to Sailing" lesson. They also provide private, relaxing two-hour cruises in the Outer Harbor and on Lake Erie, with longer cruises available upon request. Discounts are available for police officers, firefighters, and military personnel.
